title: Vendor bill in the AP subledger with no general ledger posting
prompt: Investigate why a vendor bill appears in the AP subledger but its expected posting is missing from the general ledger.

inputs.name: Integration event logs for the accounts payable connection

steps: identify the bill from the request (vendor, bill number, amount, date) and read it in Dime's AP subledger with its status
search the general ledger and journal entries for the expected posting by bill reference, vendor, amount and date
read the integration event logs for that bill: failed, skipped or pending sync events and their messages
check the period-lock state for the bill date and the bill status (draft, awaiting approval, approved, void, paid)
name the cause the evidence supports (status, lock, sync failure, posted to another date or account) and what would post it; say "could not determine" when the evidence does not
write the workbook: Exceptions holds the bill and its cause, Detail the trail

done.text: Every exception row cites the bill id and the event id or ledger row it rests on
ap-posting-investigation.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The stated cause names the event, status or lock it rests on; a cause the evidence does not support is written as "could not determine", and no posting or re-sync is proposed by the desk
